meta.title: 톡톡 스파클링
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (톡톡 스파클링, a fruit-flavoured sparkling water in three flavours (fictional drink)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 톡톡 스파클링, a fruit-flavoured sparkling water in three flavours (fictional drink)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Candy liquid on cream #FFF4E8 with faint pink dots: candy pink #FF7A93 for the brand, grapefruit #FF5C7A, lime #6ED04E and grape #9B5DE5 for the flavours, a plum ink #3B2440 for type; highlights are pure white.
rationale.type: Bagel Fat One, a round heavy display face that reads as liquid when it becomes the liquid itself; Jua for the small lines.
rationale.motion: Liquid behaviour: drops fall accelerating and stretch, land in a pool with a crown of droplets, blobs wobble with orbiting satellites that merge and split, the three flavours drift together and their colours mix, the name swells out of the pool; words pop with an overshoot.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 128 BPM in D major with a recorded kalimba (VCSL, CC0) for the plucked arpeggios; each landing is a plink, each 톡! a pop, wine-glass taps for the flavours, a swell as the name forms.
rationale.visuals: All code: a WebGL2 fragment shader sums up to 40 metaballs (r² / d², each with its colour, mixed by contribution) plus a blurred text field, takes the normal from the analytic gradient and lights it with a soft diffuse, a sharp specular, a darker rim, a brighter core and a soft offset shadow; bubbles are drawn in 2D only where the CPU copy of the field says it is liquid.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the fizz is enough.
